Proposed mission, vision, and values for VBM Quarry & Crushers. Draft wording for business review.

OUR MISSION

Support every build.
Earn every partnership.

To support construction projects with fit-for-purpose aggregates and manufactured sand, clear communication, and a responsible approach to quarrying and crushing.

OUR PURPOSE, EVERY DAY

OUR VISION

Build trust today.
Shape a better tomorrow.

To become a trusted materials partner for the communities we serve, helping build durable infrastructure while continually improving how we work, use resources, and care for our surroundings.

THE FUTURE WE WORK TOWARDS

THE PRINCIPLES BEHIND THE WORK

Values set in stone.

Our intended standards for decisions,
relationships, and everyday work.

◇

Quality with purpose

Aim to understand the application and align material requirements with the needs of each project.

＋

People & safety

Put care for people at the centre of decisions, and encourage safe, thoughtful working practices.

◎

Honest partnerships

Build trust through straightforward conversations about specifications, availability, and expectations.

⌁

Responsible progress

Seek practical ways to reduce waste, respect the surroundings, and improve how resources are used.
